review_candidates.title: Microsoft System Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Senior Systems Engineer (Remote) Location: Fully Remote Department: Information Technology Reports To: Senior Director of Systems Engineering About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Systems Engineer to serve as the primary owner of our enterprise SaaS application portfolio while acting as a secondary administrator for our Microsoft 365 environment. This role is ideal for a systems generalist with strong expertise in SaaS administration, identity and access management, Microsoft 365
eligibility_evidence: Networking & Infrastructure Support Support enterprise networking environments, including routing, switching, firewalls, DNS, and hybrid connectivity.
Strong understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including routing, switching, firewalls, DNS, and hybrid environments.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role is ideal for a systems generalist with strong expertise in SaaS administration, identity and access management, Microsoft 365, automation, and enterprise systems. Required Qualifications 7+ years of Systems Engineering experience across cloud, networking, identity management, SaaS platforms, and automation. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 technologies, including Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and Intune. Proficiency with PowerShell scripting and Microsoft Graph API.
